One problem I had, that made me revert back to using GM_getValue et al. and delay the extension, was that LocalStorage would reset each time I close Firefox. I found Simple Storage, that's probably what I will be using; I think this is what RES uses.

GM extensions operate in an 'unsafeWindow', so if you test for unsafeWindow and its there, you reassign alias localStorage: 

if (typeof(unsafeWindow) !== 'undefined') {
 localStorage = unsafeWindow.localStorage;
}

I think that may be why localStorage wasn't persisting. The MDN isn't accessible from my office but I'll be taking a look; is Simple Storage cleared when you clear your cache?
